subject: Coord: CloudWave x AWS co-sell marketplace demo — timezone check & swap
body:
Message 1 (2026-05-03T15:02:00-07:00)
From: Kevin Park <kevin@cloudwave.com>
To: camila_reyes, marissa_cole
Cc: samir@cloudwave.com
Subject: Intro + demo request: CloudWave x Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Hi Camila and Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. CloudWave has a priority opportunity with a mid-market customer that wants to evaluate Redwood via AWS Marketplace. AWS has asked for a short co-sell demo next week to put the customer in front of both Redwood and CloudWave engineering. Can we line up 30–45 minutes with an AWS marketplace rep in the loop?

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue May 5, 9:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Wed May 6, 14:00–15:00

Attaching a two-slide agenda (high level) — happy to expand. Please include whoever owns Marketplace enablement on Redwood's side and any partner engineering who can speak to integration/deployment.

Thanks,
Kevin
Head of Partnerships | CloudWave Solutions
attachments: CloudWave_Redwood_CoSell_Agenda.pdf

---

Message 2 (2026-05-04T10:12:00-07:00)
From: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Park <kevin@cloudwave.com>, marissa_cole
Cc: jonas_weber
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request: CloudWave x Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Thanks Kevin — available to help coordinate.

Jonas (copied) is our partner engineer who usually runs co-sell technical demos; Marissa will join for deal-level context. A 45-minute session works well: 25 min demo, 15 min Q&A, 5 min next steps.

Quick timezone note: I’m in PDT. I can do Tue May 5 at 11:00 PT but not the 9:00 PT slot. If you have APAC stakeholders, we should flag earlier or later options.

Proposed (PT):
- Tue May 5, 11:00–11:45 (ours is the preferred)
- Wed May 6, 14:00–14:45 (backup)

If AWS Marketplace needs to be present, please loop aws-marketplace@amazon.com — I’ll send a calendar placeholder once we lock a time.

Camila Reyes
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

---

Message 3 (2026-05-05T09:05:00-07:00)
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes, Kevin Park <kevin@cloudwave.com>
Cc: jonas_weber
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request: CloudWave x Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Quick update — I chatted with our Marketplace contact. They cannot do Tue 11:00 PT; they have a conflict until 12:30 PT. They offered Wed May 6, 15:00 PT (which would be 18:00 ET). If that works for CloudWave that would be ideal.

If CloudWave needs earlier for APAC, we can also push to Tue May 5 at 07:30 PT, but that’s before our team’s preferred hours (Jonas would join remotely).

Let me know which you prefer and I’ll create the invite and add aws-marketplace@amazon.com.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

---

Message 4 (2026-05-06T07:45:00-07:00)
From: Kevin Park <kevin@cloudwave.com>
To: camila_reyes, marissa_cole
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@cloudwave.com>, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request: CloudWave x Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Thanks Marissa — Wed May 6 at 15:00 PT would be tight for one of our APAC stakeholders (they're in IST and prefer evenings). Could we aim for Tue May 5 at 07:30 PT instead? That hits early evening for IST and still leaves time for a follow-up in the US.

If Jonas is ok with joining at 07:30 PT, we can do that. I’ve attached a short roadmap doc that the customer asked us to share before the session.

Kevin
Head of Partnerships | CloudWave Solutions
attachments: cloudwave-marketplace-roadmap.docx

---

Message 5 (2026-05-07T11:20:00-07:00)
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes, marissa_cole
Cc: Kevin Park <kevin@cloudwave.com>
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request: CloudWave x Redwood (AWS co-sell)

I can do Tue May 5 at 07:30 PT (early, but doable). A couple of logistics items:

- We’ll need to provide the customer a sandbox link and a short access runbook (I can attach the demo deck and a one-pager for the environment).
- Please confirm whether AWS Marketplace wants to see the procurement flow (listing + subscription) or just the product demo. If procurement flow is required we should add an extra 10 minutes.

I’m attaching the latest Redwood demo deck that has the marketplace screenshots.

Jonas Weber
Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf

---

Message 6 (2026-05-10T09:45:00-07:00)
From: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Park <kevin@cloudwave.com>, marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Cc: aws-marketplace@amazon.com, samir@cloudwave.com
Subject: Final: CloudWave x AWS co-sell demo — Tue May 5 07:30 PT (confirmed)

All — thanks for the flexibility. Confirming the session:

When: Tue, May 5, 2026 — 07:30–08:15 PT (45 minutes)
Where: Google Meet (calendar link below)
Owner / hosts: camila_reyes (Redwood GTM), jonas_weber (Redwood PE), Kevin Park (CloudWave)
AWS: aws-marketplace@amazon.com (cc'd) — please confirm if you want a 10-minute procurement walkthrough added.
Attendees (so far): Samir Patel (CloudWave), Marissa Cole (Redwood), additional CloudWave AM TBD

Agenda (high level):
1) 5m — Introductions & success criteria
2) 25m — Live demo (Redwood runtime + integration paths)
3) 10m — Marketplace listing / procurement flow (if AWS requests)
4) 5m — Next steps / follow-ups (MAL, POC access, timelines)

Attachments:
- CloudWave_Redwood_CoSell_Agenda.pdf
- redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf
- cloudwave-marketplace-roadmap.docx

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudwave-redwood-20260510
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-7890

Please reply-all to confirm AWS attendance and whether we should reserve the extra 10 minutes for procurement. If I don’t hear back by EOD Monday I’ll assume procurement is optional and we’ll keep the 45-minute slot.
Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0149
